'''Glower Make-Up''' was produced from the [[glower]] [[Algae/Legends|algae]] that lived in [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. It was sold on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] for twenty [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] a jar.
